issues.t: Jerky, harsh or slipping shifts from the 9-speed automatic
issues.sym: Jerks or lurches during upshifts, a slipping feel, sluggish driving after a long trip, a whine at startup, or reverse that will not engage.
issues.why: Transmission complaints are the most common XT6 problem in every model year. Dealers often try fluid flushes and software updates first, and some owners report the problem coming back.
issues.next: Have a dealer scan the transmission and check for updated software while the car is under the powertrain warranty. If it slips or will not engage a gear, stop driving it and have it towed.

issues.t: Transmission slow to upshift or downshift
issues.sym: The engine revs very high before shifting out of first gear, or the transmission will not drop a gear when climbing a hill.
issues.why: Early 2020 XT6 owners report the 9-speed holding or refusing gears, which is usually a shift-programming issue.
issues.next: Ask a dealer to check for transmission software updates and to perform a shift relearn.

issues.t: Thermostat fault with Reduced Steering Assist message
issues.sym: A check engine light, a "Steering Assist Reduced" message at startup, a missing engine temperature reading, or the radiator fan running at full speed after the engine is shut off.
issues.why: The electronically controlled thermostat can fail or open too early. The car then sets warnings and runs the fan to protect the engine; the steering message is a side effect. Owners of both the XT5 and XT6 report it.
issues.next: Have the codes read soon. The car usually still drives, but watch the temperature and do not ignore overheating. Replacing the thermostat housing is the usual fix.

issues.t: Stalling or no start from a failed fuel pump control module
issues.sym: The engine stalls while driving with several warning lights, cranks but dies after a second or two, or will not start at all. Some owners also see hesitation under load and fuel pump codes.
issues.why: The fuel pump control module, which runs the in-tank fuel pump, can fail. Dealers have described it as a widespread GM problem, and parts have sometimes been on backorder.
issues.next: If the engine stalls, get off the road safely and have it towed. Ask the dealer to check the fuel pump control module and whether warranty covers it.

issues.t: Automatic braking slams on while backing up
issues.sym: While reversing slowly with nothing close behind, the car brakes suddenly and very hard.
issues.why: The rear automatic braking system can misread an object or reflection behind the car and apply the brakes.
issues.next: Keep the rear sensors and camera clean and report it to a dealer for a software check. You can switch rear automatic braking off in settings, but stay alert when you do.

issues.t: Hesitation pulling away from a stop or after auto stop
issues.sym: The engine stumbles or hesitates when accelerating from a stop, whether it was idling or had shut off with auto stop/start.
issues.why: Owners report the stumble returning even after a new 12-volt battery. Weak batteries and stop/start software are common causes on GM vehicles with auto stop.
issues.next: Have the battery tested and ask for any engine or stop/start software updates. Until fixed, consider turning auto stop off when you need to pull out quickly.

issues.t: Dashboard top buckles in hot weather
issues.sym: The padded top of the dashboard warps or lifts in high heat.
issues.why: Owners in hot climates report the dash panel buckling; the complaint names two specific dash panel parts.
issues.next: Ask a dealer to look at it while the car is under the bumper-to-bumper warranty.

issues.t: Panoramic sunroof glass shatters
issues.sym: A loud bang followed by broken glass in the sunroof, often while driving, with nothing hitting it.
issues.why: Owners have reported XT6 sunroof glass shattering on its own. Large glass roofs can break from stress or a small chip.
issues.next: Pull over safely, cover the opening and keep glass away from passengers. File a report with NHTSA and your insurer, and ask the dealer about warranty coverage.

issues.t: Rear toe links wear out early
issues.sym: A dealer reports the rear toe links need replacing during routine service; you may notice uneven tire wear or a clunk.
issues.why: The rear toe links, small arms that keep the rear wheels pointed straight, can wear their bushings early.
issues.next: Ask whether it is covered by warranty, and have an alignment done after the links are replaced.

issues.t: Transmission fluid leak from faulty transmission bolts
issues.sym: Red fluid spots under the car, even on a nearly new vehicle.
issues.why: A dealer found faulty transmission bolts letting fluid seep out; the repair requires dropping the transmission.
issues.next: Check the fluid spot color and have it fixed under warranty before the level gets low.

issues.t: Rearview camera picture cuts out (recall)
issues.sym: The backup camera image goes black, shows a crossed-out camera icon, or flickers.
issues.why: Camera cable connectors may have been crimped badly on cars with Surround Vision (NHTSA 22V709000).
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls at nhtsa.gov or with a Cadillac dealer. The dealer replaces the camera cables for free.

issues.t: Transmission accumulator cover may be missing bolts (recall)
issues.sym: A transmission fluid leak, then possible loss of drive. Leaking fluid can catch fire.
issues.why: The start/stop accumulator end cap on the transmission may be missing bolts (NHTSA 20V668000).
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls at nhtsa.gov or with a Cadillac dealer. The dealer inspects and replaces the accumulator if needed, free.

issues.t: Fuel pump nozzle burr can stall the engine (recall)
issues.sym: The engine may stall without warning.
issues.why: A plastic burr from manufacturing may block the fuel pump jet nozzle (NHTSA 20V639000).
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls at nhtsa.gov or with a Cadillac dealer. The dealer replaces the fuel pump module for free.

issues.t: Roof-rail airbags may not inflate properly (recall)
issues.sym: No symptom until a crash.
issues.why: A part of the roof-rail airbag inflator may not be crimped properly and could separate in a deployment (NHTSA 20V446000).
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls at nhtsa.gov or with a Cadillac dealer. The dealer replaces the roof-rail airbag modules for free.

issues.t: Fuel supply lines may leak (recall)
issues.sym: A gasoline smell or wet spot under the car.
issues.why: The fuel supply lines may not be fully attached and can loosen and leak, creating a fire risk (NHTSA 21V422000).
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls at nhtsa.gov or with a Cadillac dealer. The dealer inspects and replaces the lines as needed, free. If you smell fuel, do not drive it.

issues.t: Fuel tank rollover valve may not seal (recall)
issues.sym: No symptom in normal driving.
issues.why: On AWD models the fuel tank rollover valve may not seal, which could leak fuel in a rollover crash (NHTSA 22V446000).
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls at nhtsa.gov or with a Cadillac dealer. The dealer inspects the tank and replaces it if needed, free.

issues.t: Left-rear toe link may come loose (recall)
issues.sym: A clunk, wandering, or a rear wheel that seems to steer itself.
issues.why: The left-rear toe link fastener may not have been tightened, so the link could separate and cause loss of control (NHTSA 22V427000).
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls at nhtsa.gov or with a Cadillac dealer. The dealer checks it and replaces the fastener if needed, free.

issues.t: Brake fluid cap may be missing its warning label (recall)
issues.sym: No symptom.
issues.why: The brake fluid reservoir cap may lack the required warning label, so the wrong fluid or debris could get in (NHTSA 22V392000).
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls at nhtsa.gov or with a Cadillac dealer. The dealer replaces the cap if needed, free.

issues.t: Wrong transmission sun gear can let an axle pull out (recall)
issues.sym: Loss of drive or a sudden clunk; the car may roll if parked without the parking brake.
issues.why: The transmission may have been built with the wrong sun gear, which can let the driver-side axle disengage (NHTSA 23V172000).
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls at nhtsa.gov or with a Cadillac dealer. The dealer replaces the sun gears for free.

issues.t: Tire size label may be hard to read (recall)
issues.sym: The tire information label on the driver door pillar is hard to read.
issues.why: The certification label may show illegible tire size information (NHTSA 22V708000).
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls at nhtsa.gov or with a Cadillac dealer. The dealer replaces the label for free.

issues.t: Dash indicators may not light for hazards or turn signals (recall)
issues.sym: The dash does not show the turn signal, hazard or high-beam indicator.
issues.why: Instrument panel software may not light these indicators (NHTSA 24V459000).
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls at nhtsa.gov or with a Cadillac dealer. The dealer updates the instrument panel software for free.

issues.t: Windshield may be missing its sealant (recall)
issues.sym: Possible wind noise or water leaks; the windshield may not stay in place in a crash.
issues.why: Some windshields were installed without the urethane that bonds them to the body (NHTSA 23V681000).
issues.next: Check your VIN for open recalls at nhtsa.gov or with a Cadillac dealer. The dealer inspects and reseals or replaces the windshield, free.
